remarks: Rare opportunity to own a versatile 4-bedroom, 2-bath Wheatfield ranch on nearly 7 acres. Whether you've been dreaming of a private hunting retreat, ATV paradise, or peaceful country escape, this property delivers. Abundant wildlife, frequent deer sightings, and trails ready for four-wheeling, dirt biking, hiking, or just exploring your own backyard. Inside, the home is charming, updated with a 4 bedroom layout that is hard to find at this price point in this area. The kitchen features granite countertops that bring both style and function to the heart of the home. The partially finished basement includes a TV/family room that could easily serve as a 5th bedroom, plus a separate office space. Directly across the street sits a large, beautiful park, a serious bonus for anyone who loves open green space without having to leave the neighborhood. The updates speak for themselves: brand new 24-foot pool, central AC, tankless hot water, hardwood floors that are 6 years old, a 2-year-old furnace, and up to 8 parking spaces. The right-to-farm designation adds long-term flexibility that most properties in this price range simply don't offer. Land, privacy, bedroom count, and recreational potential like this rarely hit the market in Wheatfield. If you've been looking for a home where comfort inside meets room to breathe outside, this is worth a serious look. Seller reserves the right to set offer deadline date.
